liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Garcia's vocals are inaudible and his guitar playing is tentative and lacking brilliance [18]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Vocals fade out for most of the song, but the instrumental part is strong [24]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): The reviewer considers this the best version of the song they have heard [19]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): The reviewer calls this the finest performance of the song ever recorded [25]
- **Lazy Lightnin** (1 review): The transition into Supplication is described as utterly ferocious [27]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): The reviewer calls this the best performance of the song of all time [21]
- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): The reviewer describes the performance as hot and highly energetic [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-04-12.134566.mtx.tobin.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 193 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1978-04-12.169012.mtx.seamons.ht172.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 194 min [3]. Said about its sound: Initial vocal issues in the soundboard are restored using Bob Wagner's audience recording; Clicks and static-like pops were removed during Peggy-O, Row Jimmy, and Loser [3]
- **gd1978-04-12.148071.fob.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 198 min [5]
- **gd1978-04-12.155360.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: source not stated; 22 songs; 193 min [8]
- **gd78-04-12.sbd.ashley-bertha.14085.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 174 min; rated 4.7/5 by 43 [9]. Said about its sound: The wood paneling in the small venue creates excellent acoustics for the recording; There are few sound glitches in the beginning, but the recording quality is high [22][28]
- **gd78-04-12.sbd.henry.11476.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 174 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [14]. Said about its sound: Vocals are missing for the first two songs, but the mix improves significantly later [19]

## Around the show

- Bobby and Jerry step back and launch at microphones in sync during the crescendo [20]
- A Duke student filmed the concert, and Jerry played with Ramrod on drums [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-04-12.134566.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=107256) Recording Info:SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k); Transfer Info:Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T ->… [1]. Also: The matrix mixes soundboard and audience sources, using video audio for specific patches [1]
- **gd1978-04-12.169012.mtx.seamons.ht172.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)… [3]
- **gd1978-04-12.148071.fob.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sony 54P mics > Sony TC-158 (Maxell UDXLII-C90) [5]
- **gd1978-04-12.155360.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix (48k) by Kevin Tobin; source: 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound (48k) mixed in Adobe Audition CC 2014 [8]. Also: The file was mixed by an archive.org user and converted to FLAC in 2022 [8]
- **gd78-04-12.sbd.ashley-bertha.14085.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]
- **gd78-04-12.sbd.henry.11476.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [14]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.soundstreet.us: [Grateful Dead at Duke 04/12/78 | Soundstreet.us](http://www.soundstreet.us/grateful-dead-at-duke-041278/) [31]
- Fan art by gd.lnk.to: [Grateful Dead - U.S. Blues - Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Duke University, Durham, NC, 4/12/78](https://gd.lnk.to/USBLive78) [32]
- Poster by Doug Collette: [Grateful Dead's 'Duke '78' Uncovers Complete Cameron Indoor Stadium Durham, NC 4/12/78 Show (ALBUM REVIEW) - Glide Magaz](https://glidemagazine.com/305243/grateful-deads-duke-78-uncovers-complete-cameron-indoor-stadium-durham-nc-4-12-78-show-album-review/) [33]
- Poster by www.soundstreet.us: [Grateful Dead at Duke 04/12/78 | Soundstreet.us](http://www.soundstreet.us/grateful-dead-at-duke-041278/) [34]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Duke University 4/12/78](https://www.dead.net/duke-university-4-12-78) [35]
